dzone-monster-0080.d: Wax sculpture outcasts huddled underground, always ready to give everything for the art of Master Rogers.

dzone-monster-0048.d: A servant remade to embody the "Divine Mother's" will, tasked with ensuring her commands are fulfilled.

dzone-monster-0052.d: In this moment, she acts not from madness, but from deepest faith.

dzone-monster-0174.d: She has given up resisting the erosion of "Cataclysms," and the pollution of the spirit dimension has turned the once noble and powerful Awakener completely mad.

dzone-monster-0293.d: Leader of the Aram Tribe. She will serve as their banner, blade, and shield, guiding her people to a new future and awaiting Her return.

dzone-monster-0047.d: A distorted entity forged by the High Priestess, powerful and deeply trusted.

dzone-monster-0270.d: Lily, driven to madness by eerie whispers.

dzone-monster-0196.d: "Defeat them, soothe them—but even if you glimpse my illusions, do not fall for them."

dzone-monster-0129.d: The skull of the greedy hound. Its ominous gaze has fixed upon you.

dzone-monster-0022.d: Driven by the instinct of life, it willingly sustains the parasite.

dzone-monster-0135.d: The oldest Golem in the world who came from the distant stars.
